table_guest_join_description: Enter the visit code staff gave you for table {{table}}.
table_guest_code_help: Enter the 6- or 10-character visit code shown by staff.
table_guest_code_length: Enter all 6 or 10 characters of the visit code.
table_guest_join_failed: We could not join this visit. Check the code or ask staff for a fresh one.
table_guest_ask_staff: Ask staff to confirm the table QR code and current visit code.
table_guest_account_load_failed: The account could not be refreshed. Try again or ask staff.
table_guest_ended_detail: Ask staff to start or confirm a visit before ordering again. Do not reuse a code from an earlier visit.
table_guest_unavailable_detail: Ask staff to confirm whether table visits are available.
table_guest_dine_in_unavailable: Dine-in is not available for this table visit right now. Your basket and visit remain saved in this tab.
table_guest_storage_help: This browser cannot safely keep a table visit for this tab. Enable session storage or ask staff for help.
table_guest_not_joined_detail: Scan the table QR code and enter the current visit code from staff to join.
table_guest_no_rounds: No rounds have been sent for this visit yet.
table_guest_staff_settlement: Payment is handled with staff; this account page does not collect payment.
table_guest_round_added: Your round was added to this table account.
table_guest_pending_round_notice: A previous round still needs confirmation. Resolve it before starting another round.
table_guest_left_table_confirmation: I have left this table and want to clear this visit from this tab.
table_guest_leave_action: Clear visit and return to menu
table_guest_round_explanation: This will be sent as a new kitchen batch for the current table visit. Payment is handled with staff.
table_guest_round_stale: The table account or basket changed. The basket was refreshed; review it again before sending.
table_guest_round_channel_unconfirmed: This basket is not confirmed for Dine-In yet. Review or edit it before sending this round, or ask staff for help.
table_guest_round_submit_failed: We could not confirm this round yet. Retry to check the same request before starting another.
table_guest_fingerprint_unavailable: We could not verify the reviewed basket. Refresh the basket and review it again.
table_guest_round_committed_detail: This round is confirmed. You can add another round from the menu.
table_guest_already_joined: This tab already has a table visit. Open the account or safely leave before joining another visit.
table_guest_staff_code_replacement_detai: Generating a new code replaces the current one. Guests who already joined stay connected.
table_guest_staff_code_uncertain: We could not confirm whether a code was created. Generate a replacement code to continue. Guests who already joined stay connected.
table_guest_staff_code_help_text: A guest scans the table QR and enters this code to join this visit. Example: show the 10-character code to the party seated here; it expires at the displayed time. Replacing it blocks new joins with the old code but keeps already joined guests connected.
